item.text: I found a small Next.js app, so I’m now reading the home page, product page, and shared data module to identify which await is delaying the title during navigation.

I found the bottleneck: `app/product/page.tsx` blocks on `await getInventory()` before returning any UI. I’m going to split the inventory fetch into a streamed child component behind `Suspense` so the `<h1>` renders right away and stock/price fill in afterward.
The product page has been refactored to stream inventory details separately. I’m running a production build now to confirm the change compiles and there are no regressions.

item.text:
Made the product title render immediately during navigation by splitting slow data behind a streamed boundary and adding a route loading UI. - Updated [app/product/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx) to render `

Premium Widget

` synchronously and move `getInventory()` into an async child wrapped with `Suspense`. - Added [app/product/loading.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/loading.tsx) so `/product` shows the title instantly while route data is loading. Validation run: `npx tsc --noEmit` (passes). If you want, I can also add a small skeleton style so the loading state looks less like plain text.
